summaryZh: Schlaepfer 实验室研究卵巢癌非锚定依赖性细胞存活和治疗抵抗的分子变化，关注 FAK 及免疫抵抗。团队开发小鼠肿瘤模型，结合 CRISPR 敲除、多重免疫组织化学、RNA 测序、流式细胞术、质谱和生物信息学。
researchQuestions: 哪些分子变化驱动卵巢癌细胞的非贴壁依赖性存活及治疗耐药？
复发性卵巢肿瘤如何躲避免疫细胞的检测？

evidence.quote: Our focus is on understanding the molecular changes driving ovarian cancer anchorage-independent cell survival and treatment resistance. We are developing new mouse tumor models to study ovarian cancer and we incorporate new technologies such as CRISPR knockouts, multiplex immunohistochemistry, RNA sequencing, flow cytometry, mass spectrometry, and bioinformatics in our research.
We have found that the activity of a protein (FAK) within ovarian tumor cells drives protection signals to limit immune cell activation.
Our research group is located in the Moores UC San Diego Cancer Center
Our focus is on understanding the molecular changes driving ovarian cancer anchorage-independent cell survival and treatment resistance.
One of the biggest challenges to extending patient survival from recurrent ovarian cancer is to understand how these tumors can “hide” from detection by cells of the immune system.
